confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds. Performance: one-sided lower confidence bound on paired baseline_wall/method_wall ratios must exceed 1.05. Science: two-sided confidence intervals for median paired differences must lie strictly inside each [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]; allocate alpha/2 to each of the two metrics by Bonferroni, then split each metric alpha between its two tails. Non-significance is not equivalence. Require both science metrics and valid fixed work before performance success. Apply rule separately at each sealed budget and method; report all cells, no pooled or best-cell family claim.
confidence_rule.scope_limit: Statistical equivalence of these two energy summaries cannot establish full energy-series identity or same-seed run-to-run equivalence demanded by the brief. Those stronger claims remain unverified and must not be reported as passed; changing scientific scope or margins requires a new sealed run.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work 0.8 ns molecular-dynamics benchmark has no calibrated scalar outcome curve or monotone scientific target. Preserve eight replicas, seeds 1000-1007, 25000 steps each, 100 energy samples each and unchanged model. Assess final and mean energies statistically using sealed margins; do not infer full-series identity from summaries.

power.alternative_assumption: For each metric, paired differences have zero median and independent normal seed-level errors with standard deviation at most one quarter of its sealed absolute margin. This is an unverified design assumption, not a baseline measurement.
power.justification: Eight seeds permit finite exact two-sided Bonferroni bounds for two metrics at family confidence 0.95: extreme order-statistic interval coverage is 1-2*(1/2)^8 = 0.9921875, exceeding 0.975 per metric. Under the stated normal alternative, each of 16 metric/seed differences exceeds its margin with probability about 0.00006334; a union bound gives joint equivalence power at least 0.99898, above 0.90. Correlation between metrics does not invalidate this union bound. Without the assumed paired-error scale, power is unknown.

protocol.scheduling_protocol: For each method-budget cell, run eight adjacent baseline/candidate timing pairs. Use a PRNG initialized with 271828 over menu-order methods, ascending budgets and ascending pair index to independently randomize which arm runs first. Never overlap arms. Record order and actual elapsed times, failures and budget exhaustion; never discard slow valid pairs.

splits.development: Only supplied intake, baseline outputs and profile evidence used to seal predictions.
splits.evaluation: Same pinned molecular input and seeds 1000-1007. These seeds already have baseline observations; no unseen-seed or unseen-system generalization claim. Future paired process executions are held out from method development. No adaptive seed replacement or tuning on evaluation pairs.

timing_scope.description: Time whole arm process tree from parent launch to synchronized child completion and merged output availability. Include imports, input loading, system/context creation, kernel compilation, worker launches, initialization, H2D/D2H transfer, stepping, energy sampling, context teardown and output merge/serialization. Adapter synchronizes all GPU work at boundaries. Installation excluded. Keep MPS service state fixed for both arms before timing. This is broader than baseline reported total_wall_s; remeasure both arms at identical process boundaries and do not compare candidate process wall directly to the existing 59.013547989 s reported timer.

protocol.warmup_protocol: One complete untimed fixed-work ensemble per arm before measured pairs for each method and budget, with fresh contexts and seeds 1000-1007. Retain resulting compilation cache consistently for both arms; reset physical state and random streams for every timed execution. No adaptive warmup extension.
